note: Passages only; they describe a regional SDMX/ODP 2.0 workshop and migration planning, not data stated as published, licensed or reused.

facts.fact: ICASEES, the national statistics institute, runs an Open Data Portal (ODP) at work, with a national workshop planned for end-June 2026 to update its indicators ahead of an ODIN assessment in mid-August 2026; no dataset count is given.
ICASEES confirmed at a regional meeting that a new open licence is integrated on its Open Data portal and institutional website.

note: Document date used for the portal at work (2026-06-10); licence month from the June 2026 meeting.

note: Describes a relaunched microdata archive homepage with search; does not state that data is downloadable, so no fact.

facts.fact: ICASEES's NADA platform offers microdata, databases, questionnaires and metadata for download, per the ICASEES focal point's question at a 21 May 2026 AfDB and Open Data Watch webinar; the document says NADA has no licence of its own.

note: Document date used for the NADA state, as it gives no other. No licence is stated as in force on the Open Data platform here.

slug: 2025-12-12 Central African Republic Launches Unified Digital Portal for All Public Services
note: A government services portal, not a data download site.
Payment systems case study; says nothing on published government data.

facts.fact: ICASEES's Director General described its digital dissemination ecosystem as including the Portail Open Data (ODP RCA) and the NADA data archive portal, and the ODIN/ODP administrator reported more than fifty indicators updated on ICASEES platforms; no licence or dataset count is given.

note: Workshop validating a draft data dissemination policy; names the portal as a tool but states no data published, so no fact.

facts.fact: The IMF reports that CAR launched its National Summary Data Page, a one-stop portal disseminating macroeconomic data (national accounts, prices, government operations, debt, monetary and external sectors) compiled by multiple statistical agencies, hosted by ICASEES with BEAC and the Ministry of Finance and Budget; no licence or dataset count is given.

note: Regional workshop on migrating national platforms from ODP 1.0 to 2.0; states nothing specific to CAR's published data, so no fact.

facts.fact: The ICASEES mid-term review of the national statistics strategy (7-9 October 2026) says the Open Data Portal of the Central African Republic, administered by an ICASEES webmaster, has changed the conditions of access to official statistics; no dataset count is given and the date is the document's own, 2026-10-10.
